items.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs has established a Special Control Room to monitor the Nepal floods situation. The control room operates from MEA headquarters during standard working hours. No further details on flood impacts or locations are provided in the source.

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River area of Nepal on 26 August 2026, causing loss of lives, displacement, and damage to infrastructure. As of 28 August 2026 at 15:30 hrs NST, 538 bodies have been recovered while 511 people from 33 countries remain missing out of 632. Security and disaster-management agencies continue search, rescue, and relief operations.

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue operations intensified Thursday at the mudslide-stricken Gyirong Port in Xizang, with 141 rescuers arriving that morning and another 111 from the China Search and Rescue team reaching Gyirong County by afternoon. As of 8 a.m. Thursday, three people had been killed, 558 others remained missing, and two local villagers had been rescued, while helicopters conducted assessment and search missions. An advance team is addressing an upstream blockage, and the Red Cross Society of China has sent supplies including tents, quilts, and food packages to the area.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has established an Emergency Control Room to coordinate search, rescue, information verification, and consular assistance for foreign nationals affected by or missing in the Rasuwa flash flood.  

Families may contact the Emergency Hotline/WhatsApp numbers +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 (7am–10pm) or email emergency@mofa.gov.np for details.  

Official updates are available at https://mofa.gov.np/category/flashflood/.

items.title: NDRRMA rescue coordination portal
items.summary: NDRRMA publishes rescue and coordination updates for the Bhotekoshi/Rasuwa flash flood on its official rescue portal and the SETU platform at setu.ndrrma.gov.np. Families should use these official channels for status rather than unofficial social media reposts. This site links to NDRRMA without copying individual case data.

items.title: Nepal Police official found and missing lists
items.summary: Nepal Police maintains the official Unified Database for missing persons, found persons, and unidentified remains related to the flood-affected areas. Families may search the lists at udb.nepalpolice.gov.np/missing and udb.nepalpolice.gov.np/found. Official confirmation of status comes only from Nepal Police.

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Embassy of India in Kathmandu is coordinating with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals affected by flash floods in the Rasuwa/Bhotekoshi area. Indian nationals and families may contact the MEA Special Control Room in Delhi at +91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719, WhatsApp +91-9968291988, or email situationroom@mea.gov.in. The Embassy may also be reached via WhatsApp at +977-9851316807.

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River in Nepal on 26 August 2026, causing loss of life, displacement, and damage to homes, roads, bridges, and hydropower facilities. So far, 72 bodies have been recovered while 403 people from 25 countries (203 males and 200 females, including 62 Nepali nationals) are reported missing. Security agencies and local authorities are conducting search and rescue, evacuation, and relief operations, with further updates to be issued.
